subject: Consolidating engagement stack — sandbox migration & seat redistribution
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidating engagement stack — sandbox migration & seat redistribution

Team,

We need to lock a path for consolidating our outbound engagement tooling. Current ask: put together a pilot + cutover playbook that moves a single SDR pod off Outreach into a combined Salesloft/HubSpot flow for the next 60 days so we can validate routing, templates, and reporting parity. High level requests: 

- Quick inventory of active seats and sequences (Ben: can you share the Q2 usage export?)
- License mapping (Marissa: start a draft mapping Outreach seats -> Salesloft feature parity)
- Security/compliance checks (Connor: make sure we pull the vendor SOC2 summary and the SSO configs)

Deliverables for EOD Friday: engagement-usage CSV, draft license-mapping.xlsx, and a 1-page cutover checklist. I'll coordinate the vendor discovery calls — Marta at Outreach and Victor at Salesloft should both be looped so we can get SOW and pilot pricing.

Attachments: engagement-usage-Q2.csv (stub), license-mapping-draft.xlsx (placeholder)

Thanks — I want clear decision criteria documented (reporting parity, template migration time, cost delta).

—Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating engagement stack — sandbox migration & seat redistribution

On Mon, Aug 1, 2026 at 09:12 Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team,
> 
> We need to lock a path for consolidating our outbound engagement tooling...

Got it — attaching a short usage export (engagement-usage-Q2.csv) and an initial license-mapping-draft.xlsx that maps active Outreach seats to proposed Salesloft bundles. Early notes: 

- ~42 active Outreach seats across SDR/AE teams (some are lightweight view-only).
- ~8 templates rely on Outreach-specific tokens (these will need a migration script or manual rebuild).
- We should scope a 2-week sandbox for the pilot group (6 reps + 1 manager).

Procurement heads up: if this goes live, we may request short-term seat credits from Outreach for the transition window — I will raise that with legal/procurement once we have pilot dates.

Attachments: engagement-usage-Q2.csv, license-mapping-draft.xlsx

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Growth Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@outreach.co>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Victor Chen <victor.chen@salesloft.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating engagement stack — sandbox migration & seat redistribution

Hi Irene / Marissa — thanks for the heads up and the exports.

We can support a 6-rep pilot starting Aug 17 with a lightweight SOW for migration, template replication, and a 30-day success checkpoint. Attached is a one-page pilot SOW (pilot-sow.pdf) and our compliance summary (SOC2_summary.pdf). On contractual items: Outreach is open to offering prorated credits for overlapping seats if migration completes within 45 days and we sign the SOW this month.

Proposed next steps from Outreach:
- Review SOW + scope (Irene/Marissa)
- Quick security Q&A with Connor (we'll provide SOC2 artifacts and SSO docs)
- Confirm pilot roster and cutover dates

If helpful, Victor (Salesloft) and I can do a joint 30-minute session to walk through template parity and cadence mapping.

Attachments: pilot-sow.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf

Best,
Marta Lopez
Partnerships, Outreach
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T16:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating engagement stack — sandbox migration & seat redistribution

Thanks — I put together a short cutover-plan.md draft and a risk matrix below. Key operational notes: 

- Seat redistribution: propose reallocating 10 Outreach seats that are low-use to the pilot pod rather than buying new Salesloft seats (saves ~USD 3.2k).
- Sandbox data migration: export/import of templates and sequences is ~80% automated; the remaining 20% (tokens/custom fields) require manual adjustments at the team level — plan ~4 hours per rep.
- Reporting parity: we need two fields backfilled in HubSpot to match Outreach custom metrics (I opened HS-5566 to track).

Risk matrix (brief):
- Migration slips -> template drift -> mitigated by snapshot + QA checklist
- Overlapping billing window -> request prorated credit from Outreach (Marta offered conditional credit in her note)
- Security hold-ups -> Connor to confirm SOC2 artifacts and SSO metadata availability

Requesting approval to: 1) schedule vendor joint session (30 min) next Tue/Wed, 2) ask Outreach for a 90-day credit proposal if pilot goes full migration.

Attachments: cutover-plan.md

-Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@outreach.co>, Victor Chen <victor.chen@salesloft.com>
Date: 2026-08-07T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating engagement stack — sandbox migration & seat redistribution

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Quick decisions and owners: 

- Pilot start: Aug 17 confirmed (Marissa to send roster by EOD Monday).
- Joint vendor session: schedule for Aug 10 @ 10:00 PT; Ben to book and add agenda (template mapping, reporting fields, billing cadence).
- Procurement ask: Marissa to raise credit request with Outreach and get a written proposal (90-day credit target).
- Security: Connor to review SOC2_summary.pdf and respond with any blockers by Aug 12.

I'll create a mutual action plan in the shared Drive and link to the HubSpot ticket (HS-5566) for visibility. If all items look green at the 30-day checkpoint we'll decide whether to expand to another pod.

Thanks — short and tactical here.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: pilot-sow.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf, cutover-plan.md, engagement-usage-Q2.csv, license-mapping-draft.xlsx
